display.purpose: Product name and primary landing heading.

body.purpose: Instructions, exercise text, and supporting content.

label.purpose: Small category labels and metadata headings.

shadows.name: soft-answer-panel
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for dictation answer and feedback areas.

motion.name: media-hover
motion.purpose: Video item hover and play affordance transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, used once per focused task where possible.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 58px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-fg); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: var(--primary-hover); background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--muted-text); opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: An unselected choice that stays visually quiet until hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-answer-option { min-height: 58px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, var(--text)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-answer-option:hover { border-color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-answer-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A simple writing surface with a clear keyboard focus state.
components.html: <input class="ds-text-field" aria-label="Your answer" placeholder="Type your answer…">
components.css: .ds-text-field { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-text-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--error); }

components.name: Mode Row
components.description: An open row for selecting a learning activity, with color appearing at the point of interaction.
components.css: .ds-mode-row { --row-accent: var(--primary); box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) 24px; gap: 16px; align-items: start; width: 100%; min-height: 96px; padding: 16px 12px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 4px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-mode-row:hover, .ds-mode-row:focus-visible { border-top-color: var(--row-accent); border-left-color: var(--row-accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--row-accent) 8%, var(--surface)); } .ds-mode-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mode-number { color: var(--row-accent); font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mode-row strong, .ds-mode-row small { display: block; } .ds-mode-row small { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted-text); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A compact choice control with a dark, high-contrast selected state.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-grid; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; grid-auto-flow: column; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); } .ds-segmented button { min-width: 56px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-text); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button:hover { background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text); } .ds-segmented button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--text); color: var(--background); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { position: relative; z-index: 1; outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: App Header
components.description: A compact header with understated back navigation and a narrow brand rule.
components.css: .ds-app-header { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 0 0 20px; color: var(--text); font: inherit; } .ds-app-header::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--text) 0 40%, var(--error) 40% 70%, var(--gold) 70% 100%); content: ""; } .ds-app-header a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-app-header a:last-child { color: var(--muted-text); } .ds-app-header a:last-child:hover { color: var(--text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-app-header a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Video Library Item
components.description: A media-specific card for choosing a captioned video; keep this exception limited to video browsing.
components.css: .ds-video-card { display: grid; align-content: start; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-video-card:hover { border-color: var(--text); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); } .ds-video-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-video-image { display: grid; min-height: 120px; place-items: center; background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-video-play { display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface); } .ds-video-copy { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; } .ds-video-copy small { color: var(--muted-text); font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview: DeutscheLearn feels like a calm place to work through German: focused, minimal, and friendly. The interface favors clear type, open space, and direct controls over decorative framing. Learning modes read as steps in a working process, with restrained color used to orient learners and mark important states. The light theme uses a soft near-white canvas and dark ink; the dark theme moves to charcoal surfaces and warm off-white text. Blue and teal provide the main signals, while gold and red are reserved for selected emphasis and errors. The user prefers avoiding card-heavy layouts and excess color. Keep content open and row-based wherever grouping does not need its own container.
keyCharacteristics: Minimal and approachable, with clear hierarchy.
Open rows and flat surfaces are the default.
Color identifies action, mode, or state rather than decorating empty space.

rules.name: The One Accent at a Time Rule
rules.body: Use neutral surfaces as the base; let one strong accent lead a small control group or status at a time.

rules.name: The Working Text Rule
rules.body: Keep instructions and exercise content at the body size or larger; labels are for navigation and metadata, not long explanations.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep resting content flat; reserve shadows for clear interaction or a focused task surface.

dos: Do use open rows, spacing, and thin borders before adding another card container.
Do keep primary actions blue and reserve gold and red for small, meaningful status or feedback cues.
Do preserve clear keyboard focus in both themes.
Do keep the 12-column desktop layout and single-column behavior below 820px when building within the existing shell.
Do keep media cards for thumbnail-based video selection, where the preview helps the learner choose.
donts: Don't use several saturated colors in one small group when one accent and neutrals communicate the state.
Don't wrap every section, option, or paragraph in a card; prefer open space and row separators.
Don't add decorative shadows to resting panels.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels for long instructions or body copy.
